The XikeStor SKS7300-4X4T 8-Port 10G SFP+ Uplink L2 Managed Ethernet Network Switch is a high-performance networking solution designed for enterprise, ISP, and data center environments. Featuring 4x 10G SFP+ fiber uplink ports and 4x 10G SFP+ and  10GBase-T copper combo ports, it delivers ultra-fast and reliable data transmission for bandwidth-intensive applications.

With advanced Layer 2 management capabilities, including VLAN, QoS, LACP, IGMP Snooping, and Spanning Tree Protocol, this switch ensures optimized traffic control and secure network segmentation. Its rack-mountable metal chassis and low-noise cooling system make it perfect for continuous 24/7 operation.

Key Features:

  • Model: XikeStor SKS7300-4X4T

  • Ports:

    • 4x 10G SFP+ fiber uplink slots

    • 4x 10G SFP+ / 10GBase-T RJ45 combo ports

  • Switching Capacity: Up to 160Gbps

  • Forwarding Rate: Wire-speed performance across all ports

  • Management: L2 Managed (Web GUI, CLI, Telnet)

  • Network Features: VLAN, QoS, LACP, Port Mirroring, STP/RSTP, IGMP Snooping

  • Cooling: Low-noise or fanless design (model dependent)

Compatibility:

  • Compatible with all standard 10G SFP+ transceivers (SR, LR, ER)

  • Supports DAC & AOC cables

  • Suitable for high-speed LAN, data center core, and ISP fiber aggregation
